\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

% The setup computes the shape once; drawing receives only the saved register.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{saved process}{saved process}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.7pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.3\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowssavethe\pgfutil@tempdima
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-1.5\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{2.5\pgfutil@tempdima}
}{
  \pgfsetroundjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{2.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-1.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{1.8\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-1.5\pgfutil@tempdima}{-1.8\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfillstroke
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=15mm and 22mm,
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=22mm,minimum height=9mm,align=center}
]
  \node[stage,fill=blue!8] (ingest) {Ingest};
  \node[stage,fill=yellow!15,right=of ingest] (validate) {Validate};
  \node[stage,fill=green!10,right=of validate] (publish) {Publish};
  \node[stage,fill=red!8,below=of validate] (retry) {Retry};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{saved process}] (ingest) -- node[above]{batch} (validate);
  \draw[green!50!black,line width=1pt,-{saved process}] (validate) -- node[above]{valid} (publish);
  \draw[red,line width=1.6pt,-{saved process}] (validate) -- node[right]{reject} (retry);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
